erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and 7 to 8 on Injured side.
Power cost for Blades of Ichor decreased from 1 to 0. Pursuit special rule does not need the |!hit| trigger anymore.
Heven's Wrath's Strength increased from 4 to 5 and power cost increased from 3 to 4.
Heven's Wrath's relies on the defender's |!threat| instead of the defender's |!size|.

Heven's Wrath's Cleave special rule reworked: now triggers on |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| instead of |!critical| |!critical| |!wild|, and simply grants an attack with a |!power| cost of 0, instead of restricting the additional attack to a second Heven's Wrath attack targeting the original target without the Cleave rule.
The timing for using Angelic Assassin was changed to "After this attack is resolved" instead of "When this character Dazes or KO's an enemy character with an attack"

The original text for Living Ribbons was "Enemy characters cannot place the movement tool overlapping this character's base. Enemy characters cannot reroll or change attack dice when targeting this character with attacks."
"After the attack is resolved" timing indication was added to Angelic Assassin superpower.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side.
"Playing Catch" power cost decreased from 3 to 2.
Strike does not have the Concussive Force special rule anymore (see Captain Marvel Cosmic Avengers to see its effect). It can now push Size 4 instead
X-Slam loses the Stagger special rule. It can now throw Size 4 characters instead

Big Brother can now trigger up to |!range| 4 (instead of 2). Its effect is still a taunt when attacker is in |!range| 2. It now allows for an Advance toward effect when the attacker is not within |!range| 2.
Speed increased from S to M.
Range for "X-Slam" increased from 2 to 3.
"Organic Steel" now prevents from being Pushed by enemy effects.

superPowers.body: During the |*Cleanup Phase|, remove all |<psychosis>Psychosis| tokens from this character. Then, this character rolls 5 dice. For each |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| results rolled, this character gains 1 |!power|. Then, if this character has 5 or more |!power|, this character gains a Psychosis token and drops all objective tokens it is holding.

superPowers.name: Ready to Roll

While this character has a Psychosis token, it cannot hold, Contest, or Interact with objective tokens. This character can have a maximum of one Psychosis token at any time.

Dark Miasma special rule now triggers on |!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |!failure| rather than |!critical| |!hit| |!block| |!failure|.
Flames of the Faltine's |!power| check to damage allied characters now triggers during the Cleanup Phase rather than the Power Phase.
Master of the Realm of Darkness reworked so that |!failure| results are added to the attack roll instead of counting opposing |!failure| resuilts as successes.
Peerless innate superpower added.
